description: "Such Things Are: A Play, in Five Acts" by Mrs. Inchbald is a dramatic play written in the late 18th century. The narrative revolves around the characters in the island of Sumatra, where various interactions among the English characters highlight themes of love, betrayal, and the struggle against tyranny.
